description: Every 30 minutes during the day, checks Cliniko for appointments cancelled in the last 48 hours across every configured practice. Outside the practice's cancellation window, offers up to three real open times (same practitioner and appointment type, within working hours) and raises a WorkQ item with the Practice Manager message approval form attached; inside the window, or when no times are open, raises a plain alert instead. Skips cancellations the cliniko-automations email reschedule desk already handled. Nothing is sent until approved.
